# apple_profiles (Data Source)

Lists the provisioning profiles that match every given filter.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "apple_profiles" "invalid" {
  profile_states = ["INVALID"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `bundle_id` (String) Only profiles of this bundle ID.
- `names` (Set of String) Names to match.
- `profile_states` (Set of String) States to match. Values: `ACTIVE`, `INVALID`.
- `profile_types` (Set of String) Profile types to match. Values: `IOS_APP_ADHOC`, `IOS_APP_DEVELOPMENT`, `IOS_APP_INHOUSE`, `IOS_APP_STORE`, `MAC_APP_DEVELOPMENT`, `MAC_APP_DIRECT`, `MAC_APP_STORE`, `MAC_CATALYST_APP_DEVELOPMENT`, `MAC_CATALYST_APP_DIRECT`, `MAC_CATALYST_APP_STORE`, `TVOS_APP_ADHOC`, `TVOS_APP_DEVELOPMENT`, `TVOS_APP_INHOUSE`, `TVOS_APP_STORE`.

### Read-Only

- `profiles` (Attributes List) The matching profiles, ordered by ID. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--profiles))

<a id="nestedatt--profiles"></a>
### Nested Schema for `profiles`

Read-Only:

- `created_date` (String) Creation date, in RFC 3339 format.
- `expiration_date` (String) Expiration date, in RFC 3339 format.
- `id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the profile.
- `name` (String) Name of the profile.
- `platform` (String) Platform of the profile.
- `profile_content` (String, Sensitive) The profile, base64-encoded.
- `profile_state` (String) State: `ACTIVE` or `INVALID`.
- `profile_type` (String) Profile type.
- `uuid` (String) UUID of the profile.
